name: Oluchi Freeman
source:
Oluchi's life has been shaped by a deeply religious upbringing. She has grown over the years to question her faith, which has led to her being labeled as some sort of heathen. She still attends church to avoid causing issues but she longs to let loose and have fun.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
